student_learning_goal: I can make amounts up to $200.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can make amounts up to $200.
header.character_watermark: Tappy and Lou in the top-right with the brown $100 bill. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Circle the $100 bill among 5 bills shown.
parts.visual_layout: Five bill icons in a row with one being the brown $100.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 2 find-the-bill layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 5 bills: $5 blue, $10 purple, $20 green, $50 red, $100 brown. Each circleable.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P1_FIND at Part 1: keywords name the bills circle find task.

parts.student_instructions: Draw 2 ways to make $100 (don't use the $100 bill).
parts.visual_layout: Two blank combo workspaces with $100 labels.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 2 two-way combo layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 2 blank workspaces, each labelled '$100 =' (NO $100 bill allowed).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P2_TWO at Part 2: keywords name the combos hundred without bill task.

parts.student_instructions: Make $150 with the FEWEST bills + coins.
parts.visual_layout: An empty workspace with $150 target and a piece count line.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 2 fewest-pieces workspace for money worksheet, B&W line art. Blank workspace with '$150 =' label. Below: '___ pieces' answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P3_150 at Part 3: keywords name the fewest pieces hundred-fifty task.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find a 3rd way for $100 (no $100 bill).
